strategyName: ZenBlade Session ORB + VWAP Reclaim v2

currentObservation.backtestResult: The leading combined scenario stayed slightly positive on 17999 candles per symbol, but the margin is thin and most variants are near break-even. No paper-loop integration.

lastDecision: Freeze v2 parameters. Do not integrate into Railway or paper loop. The 18000-candle test suggests a weak persistent edge in eth_btc_reclaim_quality, but fees and session-end exits consume most of it. Run frozen-parameter chronological window and fee-sensitivity validation before any further tuning.

firstV2Backtest6000.interpretation: Promising but too small: 7 to 10 trades per scenario. Four of five variants were net positive after fees/slippage.

interpretation: The combined quality scenario remained slightly positive and reached 25 trades.
Profit factor fell from 2.36 on 6000 candles to 1.21 on 18000 candles, showing that the initial sample overstated the edge.
ETH remained positive while BTC remained negative in the combined scenario.
Short-only rejection did not generalize and became net negative.
Late-US-only and long-only variants are effectively near break-even after fees.
Session-end exits are the largest visible drag, but parameters must remain frozen until window validation is complete.

researchHypothesis.type: focused session-based sweep and VWAP reclaim/rejection strategy
researchHypothesis.primaryIdea: Wait for a liquidity sweep outside the session opening range, then enter only if price reclaims or rejects VWAP with volume/impulse confirmation.
riskControls: one trade per session per symbol
cooldown day after a losing trade
no martingale or position increase after loss

knownProblems: The leading edge is thin: net 1.93 USDT on 25 trades after 8.75 USDT fees
BTC reduced the combined result while ETH remained positive
Short-only rejection failed on the longer history
Most alternative scenarios are near break-even and vulnerable to small execution changes
Session-end exits create substantial negative drag
Chronological stability has not yet been verified
The strategy may fail at a slightly higher effective fee or slippage
blockedChanges: Do not add Session ORB VWAP v2 to Railway paper loop
Do not enable live trading or real orders
Do not use OKX API keys
Do not tune session-end exits before the frozen-parameter validation
Do not remove BTC only because it was negative until time-window results are reviewed
Do not claim that short-only has edge
Do not expand to illiquid altcoins

successCriteriaForWindowValidation.minimumTrades: at least 20 in the leading scenario
successCriteriaForWindowValidation.feeSensitivity: must remain positive at current 0.0008 fee rate and preferably non-negative at 0.0010
successCriteriaForWindowValidation.paperLoopDecision: a pass still requires independent out-of-sample or forward paper observation before integration

nextResearch: Review three chronological windows for the combined quality and ETH-only scenarios
Only after window validation decide whether to test an ETH-only frozen candidate or reject the strategy
Do not modify Railway or paper loop
